function.name: getApricotRecord
function.description: Get a participant/client record from Apricot360 by record ID. Use this to fetch participant data for form filling.

recordId.description: The unique record ID of the participant

function.name: getApricotForms
function.description: Fetch forms from Apricot360 with optional pagination and filtering.

pageSize.description: Number of forms to return per page (default: 25)

sort.description: Field to sort by (e.g., "name", "-name" for descending)

function.name: getApricotForm
function.description: Get a specific form from Apricot360 by form ID.

formId.description: The unique ID of the form in Apricot360

function.name: getApricotFormFields
function.description: Get all fields for a specific form from Apricot360. Returns field definitions including labels, types, options, and validation requirements.

formId.description: The unique ID of the form in Apricot360

function.name: testApricotAuth
function.description: Test authentication with Apricot360 API. Use this to verify API credentials are working.

function.name: gapAnalysis
function.description: Shows the caseworker a card listing ONLY the missing fields, in the order they appear on the original form. Calling this tool ends your turn — do not call any other tools after it; wait for the caseworker's reply. Include only missing fields, no fields you already have. After calling, write one short sentence like "Please provide the missing info above." and stop. If nothing is missing, do not call this tool.

formName.description: Name of the form being filled, e.g. "WIC Application"

clientName.description: Full name of the participant the form is being filled for

missingFields.description: Missing fields in the order they appear on the original form.

multiSelect.description: Whether multiple options can be selected

condition.description: Condition under which this field is required, e.g. "if pregnant"

required.description: Whether this field is required to submit the form

placeholder.description: Placeholder hint shown inside the input

note.description: Short helper text shown under the field label

function.name: formSummary
function.description: Display a form summary card showing what was filled in and where each value came from. Call this INSTEAD of writing a summary message at the end of form completion. List fields in the order they appear on the original form. NEVER include CAPTCHA, reCAPTCHA, Turnstile, "I'm not a robot", or any bot-challenge widget — they are not form fields. Also exclude submit buttons, hidden inputs, and decorative text. The card already displays all information — do NOT write any text listing the fields before or after calling this tool. Just call the tool, then follow with one short sentence like "Please review and submit when ready."

formName.description: Name of the form that was filled, e.g. "WIC Application"

clientName.description: Full name of the participant the form was filled for

fields.description: All form fields in the order they appear on the original form. Each field has a source indicating where the value came from.

value.description: Value that was filled in. Omit or leave empty for fields that could not be filled.

source.description: "database" = pulled from Apricot records, "caseworker" = provided by the caseworker this session, "inferred" = agent reasoned from available data, "missing" = field could not be filled

inputType.description: Type of input the form field uses. Use "select" for dropdowns, "radio" for single-choice radio buttons, "checkbox" ONLY for fields that allow multiple simultaneous selections, or omit for plain text.

options.description: REQUIRED for select/radio/checkbox fields. Every available choice exactly as the form labels it. The value you pass MUST match one of these strings character-for-character or the dropdown will render empty.

required.description: Whether the field is required to submit the form

inferredFrom.description: For inferred fields only: a short description of what the value was based on, e.g. "the zipcode", "the client's date of birth", "the household size"

function.name: actionLabel
function.description: Label the upcoming group of browser actions with a human-readable title. Call this ONCE before starting a sequence of related browser actions so the UI can show a meaningful group heading. Do NOT call it before every individual action — only at the start of a logical group.

category.description: Type of action group, used to select the UI icon and label.

function.name: browser
function.description: Execute browser automation commands on a remote Kernel browser. Send structured JSON commands with an "action" field and action-specific parameters. Actions include navigate, snapshot, click, fill, type, select, getbylabel, press, hover, check, uncheck, scrollintoview, wait, waitforloadstate, gettext, inputvalue, url, title, scroll, screenshot, back, forward, evaluate, tab management, dialog, frame. ALWAYS snapshot first. NEVER navigate away from the target application domain.

parameters.description: Structured command object with action and action-specific parameters

selector.description: Element selector: ref (@e1), CSS (#id), or label

values.description: Option values for select action — must be an array

timeout.description: Timeout in ms for wait action — must be a number

amount.description: Scroll amount in px — must be a number

delay.description: Delay between keystrokes in ms — must be a number

interactive.description: Show only interactive elements in snapshot — must be boolean

clear.description: Clear field before typing — must be boolean

promptText.description: Text to enter in prompt dialog

function.name: checkSubmitGate
function.description: Call when the submit button is disabled and the page has a Cloudflare Turnstile widget. Probes the DOM, then force-enables the button so the caseworker can take control and submit. Never clicks submit.

forceEnable.description: If true, after probing also force-enable the submit button (invoke Turnstile callback if present, then remove disabled attribute).

function.name: readReference
function.description: Load a reference document. Use the path the system prompt instructs you to load (e.g. "field-patterns.md", "custom-dropdowns.md", "browser-commands.md").
